initial_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: The user requires energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C. Other requested parameters (60 beds, 850 sqm GFA, Turin, CDP/PNRR funding, proximity to public transport) are not energy efficiency columns and are not filtered here.
User requires the building to be near public transport. Per the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), the value is rounded to 71.

A university student residence is essentially dependent on nearby education facilities (universities and schools). Per the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), the value is rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-bed capacity is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold per bed was supplied. Energy class, public transport proximity, and CDP/PNRR funding are outside the reference columns and are not filtered here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on office-type properties (property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili', the canonical name of tipologia_bene_immobile) with surface_area >= 850, energy_class A1-A4/B/C, and mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Location is limited to a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892) and results are ordered by distance from that point. The 60-bed, CDP/PNRR and other non-extracted details are not included.
